title: Renon — synthetic TLS scan (HELIOS++)
description: Terrestrial laser scan SIMULATED with HELIOS++ from the single-tree inventory (87 trees) of the same Renon site: procedural tree models (stem + crown, from DBH/height) at their measured positions, sampled from several TLS positions. 2,329,411 points (after thinning), coloured by height. The value lies in the KNOWN truth — every tree parameter is set, not estimated: a basis for benchmarking inventory algorithms and for scenarios (rescanning stands projected with TreeGrOSS). Not a real measurement. Simulator: HELIOS++ (3DGeo Heidelberg); scene from scripts/helios_scene.py.
